Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India — On-site
Department: Product / Assessment Research
CareerMaker.ai is revolutionizing the journey from education to employment by bridging the gap between academic learning and real-world job readiness.
Our mission is to make employability measurable, personalized, and actionable, helping students understand where they stand and what they need to do to become job-ready.
We are looking for a highly detail-oriented Assessment Research Intern to support the research and development of our AI-powered Assessment platform.
This role is primarily focused on researching, analysing, and systematically mapping assessment methodologies, question frameworks, evaluation models, and skill measurement approaches across different types of assessments.
You will research how aptitude, technical, domain, behavioural, and other skill-based assessments are designed and evaluated. You will study question structures, difficulty levels, skill mapping, scoring approaches, assessment patterns, and evaluation methodologies, and convert your findings into structured research frameworks and datasets.
Your work will directly contribute to the research foundation behind CareerMaker.ai's Assessment AI, helping the product generate high-quality, relevant, and well-structured assessments.
You will work closely with the Product and Assessment teams to translate research findings into structured requirements, frameworks, taxonomies, and knowledge systems for the AI platform.
This role is ideal for someone who genuinely enjoys deep research, reading, analysing information, identifying patterns, comparing methodologies, and converting complex information into structured knowledge.
-Research different types of assessments used for aptitude, technical, domain, behavioural, cognitive, and other skill-based evaluations.
-Study established assessment frameworks, testing methodologies, question formats, evaluation models, and scoring approaches.
-Research how assessment questions are designed, structured, categorised, calibrated, and evaluated.
-Identify and document different question types, question structures, response formats, and assessment patterns.
-Analyse assessment platforms, test repositories, question banks, academic resources, research papers, and other credible sources.
-Compare assessment methodologies across different platforms, domains, and use cases.
-Categorise questions based on skill, topic, sub-topic, difficulty, cognitive level, question type, response type, and other relevant dimensions.
-Identify patterns and common frameworks across large sets of assessment questions.
-Research how difficulty levels are defined, measured, and maintained across different assessments.
-Study how different assessments measure specific skills, competencies, and knowledge areas.
-Build and maintain structured databases, taxonomies, research documents, and assessment frameworks.
-Convert unstructured research findings into structured and machine-readable information that can support AI systems.
-Identify gaps, inconsistencies, ambiguities, and opportunities for improvement in existing assessment methodologies.
-Review research and documentation for accuracy, consistency, completeness, and logical organisation.
Work with the Product and Assessment teams to translate research findings into requirements for the Assessment AI.
-Continuously update research frameworks and documentation as new assessment methodologies, question formats, and evaluation approaches are identified.
-Strong research and information-gathering skills.
-Excellent reading, comprehension, and analytical abilities.
-Ability to analyse large amounts of information and identify meaningful patterns.
-Strong ability to compare, categorise, and structure information systematically.
-Strong written English and the ability to communicate research findings clearly.
-Comfortable working with spreadsheets, documents, databases, and structured datasets.
-Ability to work independently and follow a systematic research process.
-Strong organisational and documentation skills.
-Curiosity about assessments, education, AI, testing, learning, psychology, or technology.
-Ability to distinguish reliable and credible information sources from low-quality sources.
-Bachelor's degree in Arts, Humanities, Social Sciences, Psychology, Education, or any other relevant field.
-Prior experience in research, academic research, assessment, documentation, data analysis, or similar work is a plus.
-Familiarity with Excel / Google Sheets, Google Docs, Notion, or similar tools is a plus.
-Candidates with strong research and analytical abilities are encouraged to apply even without prior industry experience.
-Hands-on experience conducting research for a real-world AI product.
-Exposure to assessment design, evaluation methodologies, question frameworks, and skill measurement.
-Experience researching and analysing large-scale assessment systems and question databases.
-Experience converting research findings into structured frameworks and datasets for AI systems.
-Exposure to how research is translated into product requirements and AI capabilities.
-Opportunity to work closely with Product and Assessment teams.
-Experience at the intersection of AI, assessment, education, research, and technology.
-Opportunity to build expertise in assessment research and AI-powered evaluation systems.
